message.content:
**Slide 1 (Cover)**
**PASS.** Clean layout with correct hierarchy, aligned dividers, and no visual cliches; the dark theme is consistent and professional.

**Slide 2 (Executive Summary)**
**PASS.** Strong typographic hierarchy, balanced two-column whitespace, and clean data presentation without AI-generated card clutter.

**Slide 3 (Architecture)**
**FAIL.** The right-hand module list uses a light gray background box with internal dividers, creating a "card" visual that clashes with the strict editorial style of the rest of the deck.

**Slide 4 (Multi-tenancy)**
**FAIL.** The code block on the right is enclosed in a shaded rectangular container, which is an "AI-generated" visual cliche (rounded/shadowed card element) inconsistent with the hairline-divider aesthetic.

**Slide 5 (Encryption)**
**FAIL.** Similar to the previous slide, the data display panel on the right sits inside a visible background box, breaking the editorial style by introducing a distinct UI container element.
